categories.name: Standard Procurement Flow
categories.description: Standard purchasing and invoicing paths with predictable sequences, moderate lead times, and clean execution.
categories.rationale: Represents the most frequent baseline purchasing processes (e.g. V0001, V0002) which lack extreme durations or rework anomalies.

categories.name: Short/Low-Touch Flow
categories.description: Short trace lengths consisting of early-stage procurement actions, rapid deletions, or immediate creation/goods receipt actions without full invoicing loops.
categories.rationale: Captures low-length traces like simple order creations, deletions, or quick receipts (e.g. V0003, V0009, V0014, V0024) with minimal operational footprint.

categories.name: Service Entry & Minor Rework
categories.description: Flows centered around service entry sheets with minor repetitions or immediate low-duration completions.
categories.rationale: Reflects execution patterns featuring service entry and goods receipt loops or small repetitions without exploding into massive delays (e.g. V0064, V0162, V0244, V0271).

categories.name: SRM Integration Anomaly
categories.description: Flows involving SRM sub-system milestones, transfers, transmission changes, or system transfer failures.
categories.rationale: Isolates complex variants tied to SRM tracking states and transfer errors (e.g. V2944, V2952, V2950, V2949, V2947, V2946, V2948) which exhibit specialized messaging.

categories.name: Extreme Duration and Churn
categories.description: Massive trace lengths, extensive document cancellations, repetitive invoice postings, and multi-year durations.
categories.rationale: Captures extreme outliers characterized by hundreds of activities, pervasive churn, invoice cancellations, and massive wait times spanning thousands of days (e.g. V1038, V3680, V3305, V3102, V3074, V6776, V5418).
